title: Rules.
bodyText: Subject to chapter 91, the director shall adopt reasonable rules for determining the prevailing wages, enforcement, administration, and general purposes of this chapter. These rules shall have the force and effect of law.
bodyHtml: §104-29  Rules.  Subject to chapter 91, the director shall adopt reasonable rules for determining the prevailing wages, enforcement, administration, and general purposes of this chapter.  These rules shall have the force and effect of law. [L 1995, c 181, pt of §2]
